why: The replacement main picture, now the homepage lead, is still a stand-in. It is a 2018 file photo of Puri speaking at a plastics recycling and waste management conference. The banner reading 'International Conference on Plastics Recycling & Waste Management, 28th September 2018' takes up most of the frame, Puri is a small figure at the left edge and four unrelated panellists fill the rest. It does not match a Rajya Sabha election story and looks lazy for the lead.
